name: Choice Bound
teaser: A mod that introduces new accounts / profiles with both positive and negative, short-term and long-term effects. Adding challenge and flavor. Heavy inspiration from Zero to Hero but with more depth.
description_html:
I’m not actively working on choice bound, if you want a profile added, comment and I might add it sometime in the future.

Please Note.

This is my first time modding Tarkov, and the entire “balance” of this mod so far is pretty much my opinion. With some inputs from the SPT server and my friends. So I do get if these profiles are not the best, if you have any suggestions add it in the comments or message me on discord with the idea [ PureRussianVodka ] (if you do message me there, please say you came from the mod page. I get a lot of spam)

PS: If your an artist and want to make an icon for Choice Bound, hit me up.

Mod Info

Firstly, HUGE Thanks to ShadowXtrex for letting me use his mod “custom profiles” as a framework to Choice Bound, helping me in its early stages and how to start moding in general.

Special thanks to acidphantasm - for helping me fix choice bound in 1.1.0

!Important PLEASE READ!
Starting with Trader rep less than 1.0 rep makes it so you cant access the traders inventory (besides fence) for buying. Until you reach 1.0 rep. Treat 1.0 rep as the new baseline from 0.0 this was done because a negative number caused issues with traders.

What are the effects?

Currently, its done by modifying the starting : trader rep, stash sizes, equipment and money. (more coming soon tm )

Who is this mod for?

This mod is perfect for players who love challenging starts, similar to the “zero to hero” concept, or just are bored with tarkovs accounts / profiles and crave for more variation and lasting impacts.

How to download

Move Choice Bound mod into the \mods folder in your SPT folder

Possible Questions

-What comes next? Adding config to decide if trader inventory should be disabled if Trader rep is bellow 1

Adding more profiles and making each of them appealing for their own reasons. is priority number 1.

A config to disable profiles that is built in SPT

After that id like to add a custom quest for resolving debts / Unique quests for profiles (if thats even possible. meaning it may not happen)

-Does this work with MPT/Fika?

Yes, suffer with friends.

-Can I remove Defaults SPT profiles?

At the moment this mod has no official way to remove them, ill add a config once I figure it out how.

-Is this compatible with (X) mod?
